_what: Predeclared BEFORE any W1 run: which PRD functional requirements (the stories' `covers` ids) each hidden-oracle test exercises, derived from the PRD's FR titles (FR-1 NFC keys, FR-2 hash chain, FR-3 idempotent replay, FR-4 conflict by rid, FR-5 tombstones, FR-6 verify from disk, FR-7 verifier trusts no cache, FR-8 atomic apply_batch, FR-9 deterministic snapshot, FR-10 repair truncated tail only, FR-11 CLI subcommands, FR-12 exit-code contract, FR-13 fsync, FR-14 no network/subprocess/extra files). Used by w1_driver.py to decide whether a red oracle test sits on a story the framework marked DONE (FALSE PASS) or on one it did not (a correctly classified product failure). A complete run (every story DONE) makes every red test a FALSE PASS regardless of the map.
